graceDays.description: Days from now until the room's content is purged. `0` purges at once, and cannot be undone. Absent: the community's configured default (30 days in the reference implementation). On a room already scheduled for removal, replaces its `purgeAt` with now plus this.

Response.title: VTC Rooms Community Remove — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/community/remove. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/community/remove/0.1#response. The room as it now stands — `removalScheduled` with its `purgeAt`, or `purging` when `graceDays` was `0` — and, where the community's VTA reset the room's credentials at its host, the revocation list in force there.

revocation.description: Present when this removal reset the room — it was archived `readOnly` — as the room's host accepted it. Absent when the room was already `noAccess`, whose reset is already in force.
